enrich.rationale: Residual-driven active learning will place new solves where the current winner demonstrably underperforms along the correlated inputs, yielding more RMSE reduction per added sample than blind sampling.

diagnosis: The surrogate is sample-bottlenecked with structured, input-correlated residuals (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip), so current errors are dominated by under-sampled/weak regions rather than split noise or pure hyperparameter tuning.
